Doing the surface right means breaking every source file, and the more right it is the more a maintainer has to accept at once. 547 clause sites across 67 files, plus 1527 inside Rust string literals, is not a diff anyone reviews line by line — so the correctness of the change is what makes it hard to land, and the pressure is toward proposing the subset that reviews easily rather than the one that is right.

```day-tension
{"between":["it-lands-upstream","surface-serves-agents"]}
```
